hypothesis: Verify whether _decision_classify properly sanitizes invisible characters and outer <user_input_*> envelopes before sending input to gemini-decision-1, validates Mapping response structure, disables Speakeasy built-in multi-attempt exponential backoff, and avoids unhandled exceptions or circuit-breaker pollution on 429 or timeout.

Verify whether extract_search_queries_with_lite escapes XML delimiter tags (<user_query>, <conversation_history>, <trip_destination>) after stripping invisible format characters across both user input and history turns, bounds timeout within 3.2s, avoids recording model errors on empty mock responses, and rejects off-topic Wikipedia entries via distilled search_query matching.

Verify whether prune_and_align_citations enforces strict 1-to-1 citation alignment when [i] markers exist, prevents generic CJK/English filler stopwords and standalone year digits from matching unrelated sources when markers are absent, while matching genuine CJK entity phrases.

Verify whether sanitize_config_for_model strips sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k) and thinking_budget for gemini-3* and gemini-4-* models, clamps unsupported xhigh on gemini-3* and minimal on gemini-4*, and maintains safe max_output_tokens floors (>=16384 or >=32768 for PLANNING/PARSE_MD).

Verify whether stream_chat_generator strictly emits final_sources from prune_and_align_citations without re-injecting uncited candidate_sources[:2] when prune_and_align_citations returns an empty list.

Verify whether the fallback path when env.SESSION_SECRET is unset strips both X-User-ID and raw Authorization headers before calling env.POI_SERVICE, rather than forwarding an unverified Authorization header that downstream poi-service parses without signature verification.

Verify whether extractUserId performs cryptographic signature validation when reading Bearer tokens via atob() or relies solely on upstream gateway header sanitization, and whether external routing exposure exists when workers_dev is not explicitly set to false.
